_comment: Editable interpretation corpus for Lore's natal report. Sign/planet/house names must match the app's enum names. Text is combined generatively by ChartInterpreter.

signTraits.Aries: bold, direct, and eager to lead
signTraits.Taurus: steady, sensual, and devoted to comfort and security
signTraits.Libra: charming, fair-minded, and drawn to harmony

roleFraming.Moon: Emotionally, {name} tends to be {trait}, and needs security that honours that nature.
roleFraming.Rising: To the world, {name} first comes across as {trait}.

planetThemes.Uranus: independence and the urge to break convention
planetThemes.North Node: the evolving direction of this life
planetThemes.Chiron: a core wound and the capacity to heal it
planetThemes.Lilith: raw instinct, primal autonomy, and the untamed, unapologetic self

_planetInSign_comment: Bespoke Planet-in-Sign readings, keyed 'Planet|Sign'. Preferred by ChartInterpreter over the templated planetThemes+signStyles blend. Phrased to be followed by ', colouring <house area>.'

planetInSign.Sun|Aries: Identity burns brightest through bold initiative, courage, and the drive to be first
planetInSign.Sun|Taurus: Identity is grounded in steadiness, sensual pleasure, and the patient building of lasting security
planetInSign.Sun|Gemini: Identity comes alive through curiosity, conversation, and a mind that thrives on variety
planetInSign.Sun|Cancer: Identity is rooted in feeling, memory, and the instinct to nurture and protect
planetInSign.Sun|Leo: Identity shines through warmth, creativity, and a natural wish to be seen and to lead
planetInSign.Sun|Virgo: Identity expresses through usefulness, careful analysis, and the quiet craft of improvement
planetInSign.Sun|Libra: Identity is found in relationship, fairness, and the pursuit of beauty and balance
planetInSign.Sun|Scorpio: Identity runs deep and intense, drawn to truth, power, and transformation
planetInSign.Sun|Sagittarius: Identity seeks meaning through freedom, adventure, and the widening of horizons
planetInSign.Sun|Capricorn: Identity is built through discipline, ambition, and a steady climb toward mastery
planetInSign.Sun|Aquarius: Identity asserts itself through originality, independence, and a vision for the collective future
planetInSign.Sun|Pisces: Identity dissolves into imagination, compassion, and a longing for the transcendent
planetInSign.Moon|Aries: Emotionally quick and direct, needing action and independence to feel alive
planetInSign.Moon|Taurus: Emotionally steady and comfort-seeking, needing security, routine, and physical ease
planetInSign.Moon|Gemini: Emotionally restless and curious, needing mental stimulation and someone to talk to
planetInSign.Moon|Cancer: Emotionally deep and tender, needing home, belonging, and to care for others
planetInSign.Moon|Leo: Emotionally warm and dramatic, needing recognition, affection, and a creative outlet
planetInSign.Moon|Virgo: Emotionally reserved and analytical, needing order and usefulness to feel safe
planetInSign.Moon|Libra: Emotionally attuned to others, needing harmony, partnership, and peaceful surroundings
planetInSign.Moon|Scorpio: Emotionally intense and private, needing depth, trust, and complete honesty
planetInSign.Moon|Sagittarius: Emotionally buoyant and freedom-loving, needing room to roam and a sense of possibility
planetInSign.Moon|Capricorn: Emotionally guarded and self-contained, needing competence, structure, and quiet respect
planetInSign.Moon|Aquarius: Emotionally cool and detached, needing friendship, space, and intellectual freedom
planetInSign.Moon|Pisces: Emotionally sensitive and porous, needing solitude, beauty, and a way to escape the ordinary
planetInSign.Mercury|Aries: Thinks and speaks quickly, bluntly, and with decisive, pioneering energy
planetInSign.Mercury|Taurus: Thinks slowly and thoroughly, reaching practical, deliberate, and unshakeable conclusions
planetInSign.Mercury|Gemini: Thinks fast and flexibly, delighting in facts, wit, and constant conversation
planetInSign.Mercury|Cancer: Thinks with feeling and memory, communicating in an intuitive, protective way
planetInSign.Mercury|Leo: Thinks boldly and speaks with warmth, drama, and creative confidence
planetInSign.Mercury|Virgo: Thinks precisely and critically, with a gift for detail, analysis, and craft
planetInSign.Mercury|Libra: Thinks in terms of balance and fairness, communicating with tact and diplomacy
planetInSign.Mercury|Scorpio: Thinks deeply and probingly, drawn to secrets, motives, and hidden truths
planetInSign.Mercury|Sagittarius: Thinks big and philosophically, speaking frankly about meaning and possibility
planetInSign.Mercury|Capricorn: Thinks in structured, strategic terms, communicating with authority and economy
planetInSign.Mercury|Aquarius: Thinks originally and objectively, drawn to ideas, systems, and the unconventional
planetInSign.Mercury|Pisces: Thinks in images and impressions, communicating poetically and intuitively
planetInSign.Venus|Aries: Loves ardently and directly, drawn to excitement, pursuit, and passionate spontaneity
planetInSign.Venus|Taurus: Loves sensually and loyally, valuing comfort, beauty, and steadfast devotion
planetInSign.Venus|Gemini: Loves playfully and curiously, drawn to wit, variety, and lively conversation
planetInSign.Venus|Cancer: Loves tenderly and protectively, valuing emotional safety and deep belonging
planetInSign.Venus|Leo: Loves generously and dramatically, valuing romance, loyalty, and warm admiration
planetInSign.Venus|Virgo: Loves through devotion and service, valuing sincerity, usefulness, and quiet care
planetInSign.Venus|Libra: Loves gracefully and fairly, valuing partnership, harmony, and refined beauty
planetInSign.Venus|Scorpio: Loves intensely and all-or-nothing, valuing depth, loyalty, and total intimacy
planetInSign.Venus|Sagittarius: Loves freely and adventurously, valuing honesty, laughter, and shared exploration
planetInSign.Venus|Capricorn: Loves seriously and enduringly, valuing commitment, respect, and lasting stability
planetInSign.Venus|Aquarius: Loves unconventionally and as a friend first, valuing freedom and intellectual kinship
planetInSign.Venus|Pisces: Loves romantically and compassionately, valuing tenderness, devotion, and soulful connection
planetInSign.Mars|Aries: Acts boldly and impulsively, with raw courage and a will to charge straight ahead
planetInSign.Mars|Taurus: Acts steadily and stubbornly, with slow-building force and remarkable staying power
planetInSign.Mars|Gemini: Acts through words and wit, with restless, quick-changing, easily scattered energy
planetInSign.Mars|Cancer: Acts indirectly and protectively, driven by emotion and the defense of loved ones
planetInSign.Mars|Leo: Acts with pride and flair, driven to lead, perform, and win admiration
planetInSign.Mars|Virgo: Acts efficiently and methodically, driven to perfect, refine, and get things right
planetInSign.Mars|Libra: Acts through cooperation and persuasion, driven by fairness and the avoidance of conflict
planetInSign.Mars|Scorpio: Acts with intense, controlled power, driven by desire, strategy, and sheer willpower
planetInSign.Mars|Sagittarius: Acts enthusiastically and restlessly, driven by adventure, freedom, and conviction
planetInSign.Mars|Capricorn: Acts with discipline and patience, driven by ambition and the long climb to the top
planetInSign.Mars|Aquarius: Acts independently and unpredictably, driven by principle and the urge to reform
planetInSign.Mars|Pisces: Acts subtly and elusively, driven by imagination, compassion, and shifting inspiration
planetInSign.Jupiter|Aries: Grows through bold action, initiative, and the courage to pioneer new paths
planetInSign.Jupiter|Taurus: Grows through patience, material abundance, and steady enjoyment of life's pleasures
planetInSign.Jupiter|Gemini: Grows through learning, communication, and a wide network of ideas and contacts
planetInSign.Jupiter|Cancer: Grows through nurturing, home, and warm emotional generosity toward others
planetInSign.Jupiter|Leo: Grows through creativity, confidence, and wholehearted, generous self-expression
planetInSign.Jupiter|Virgo: Grows through service, skill, and the diligent improvement of everyday work
planetInSign.Jupiter|Libra: Grows through relationship, fairness, and the cultivation of beauty and balance
planetInSign.Jupiter|Scorpio: Grows through depth, transformation, and the fearless exploration of the hidden
planetInSign.Jupiter|Sagittarius: Grows through travel, higher learning, and an ever-expanding search for meaning
planetInSign.Jupiter|Capricorn: Grows through discipline, responsibility, and the patient building of lasting achievement
planetInSign.Jupiter|Aquarius: Grows through innovation, community, and a generous vision of the common good
planetInSign.Jupiter|Pisces: Grows through faith, compassion, and imaginative or spiritual devotion
planetInSign.Saturn|Aries: Learns patience and self-restraint, tempering impulse with hard-won discipline
planetInSign.Saturn|Taurus: Learns security through effort, facing lessons around money, worth, and stability
planetInSign.Saturn|Gemini: Learns disciplined thought and speech, taking ideas and communication seriously
planetInSign.Saturn|Cancer: Learns emotional maturity, facing lessons around family, security, and vulnerability
planetInSign.Saturn|Leo: Learns humble, earned confidence, disciplining pride into steady creative authority
planetInSign.Saturn|Virgo: Learns through work and precision, facing lessons around perfectionism and self-criticism
planetInSign.Saturn|Libra: Learns commitment and fairness, taking relationships and responsibility seriously
planetInSign.Saturn|Scorpio: Learns through control and release, facing lessons around power, trust, and depth
planetInSign.Saturn|Sagittarius: Learns disciplined belief, grounding restless idealism into tested conviction
planetInSign.Saturn|Capricorn: Learns mastery through duty, ambition, and the long, patient road to authority
planetInSign.Saturn|Aquarius: Learns responsibility to the group, disciplining ideals into lasting reform
planetInSign.Saturn|Pisces: Learns to structure the intangible, facing lessons around boundaries and escapism
planetInSign.Uranus|Aries: Breaks convention through bold, pioneering independence and sudden, decisive action
planetInSign.Uranus|Taurus: Breaks convention around money, resources, and values, upending material security
planetInSign.Uranus|Gemini: Breaks convention in thought and communication, championing radical new ideas
planetInSign.Uranus|Cancer: Breaks convention around home and family, redefining what security and roots mean
planetInSign.Uranus|Leo: Breaks convention through unique self-expression, rebelling in creativity and romance
planetInSign.Uranus|Virgo: Breaks convention in work and health, revolutionizing method, craft, and routine
planetInSign.Uranus|Libra: Breaks convention in relationships, seeking freedom and equality in partnership
planetInSign.Uranus|Scorpio: Breaks convention around power and intimacy, forcing deep, radical transformation
planetInSign.Uranus|Sagittarius: Breaks convention in belief and philosophy, championing radical truth and freedom
planetInSign.Uranus|Capricorn: Breaks convention in structures and authority, overturning outworn institutions
planetInSign.Uranus|Aquarius: Breaks convention naturally and brilliantly, at home in innovation and reform
planetInSign.Uranus|Pisces: Breaks convention through spiritual and imaginative awakening, dissolving old certainties
planetInSign.Neptune|Aries: Dreams of heroic action, idealizing courage, independence, and bold beginnings
planetInSign.Neptune|Taurus: Dreams of beauty and peace, idealizing nature, comfort, and material harmony
planetInSign.Neptune|Gemini: Dreams through words and ideas, idealizing communication and the flow of information
planetInSign.Neptune|Cancer: Dreams of belonging, idealizing home, family, and emotional oneness
planetInSign.Neptune|Leo: Dreams through creativity and romance, idealizing self-expression and glamour
planetInSign.Neptune|Virgo: Dreams of perfection and service, idealizing health, purity, and useful work
planetInSign.Neptune|Libra: Dreams of perfect union, idealizing love, harmony, and refined beauty
planetInSign.Neptune|Scorpio: Dreams of profound transformation, idealizing intensity, mystery, and rebirth
planetInSign.Neptune|Sagittarius: Dreams of ultimate meaning, idealizing faith, freedom, and far horizons
planetInSign.Neptune|Capricorn: Dreams of ideal order, dissolving or idealizing structures, authority, and ambition
planetInSign.Neptune|Aquarius: Dreams of utopia, idealizing progress, community, and collective awakening
planetInSign.Neptune|Pisces: Dreams most deeply here, idealizing compassion, spirituality, and boundless unity
planetInSign.Pluto|Aries: Transforms through will and courage, reshaping identity in fierce new beginnings
planetInSign.Pluto|Taurus: Transforms values and resources, reshaping security through deep material upheaval
planetInSign.Pluto|Gemini: Transforms thought and communication, reshaping how a generation thinks and speaks
planetInSign.Pluto|Cancer: Transforms home and family, reshaping emotional roots and the meaning of security
planetInSign.Pluto|Leo: Transforms self-expression and power, reshaping creativity, ego, and authority
planetInSign.Pluto|Virgo: Transforms work and health, reshaping labor, craft, and attitudes to the body
planetInSign.Pluto|Libra: Transforms relationships, reshaping partnership, equality, and social contracts
planetInSign.Pluto|Scorpio: Transforms at the deepest level, reshaping power, intimacy, and the hidden
planetInSign.Pluto|Sagittarius: Transforms belief and truth, reshaping religion, philosophy, and global vision
planetInSign.Pluto|Capricorn: Transforms structures and authority, reshaping institutions, power, and ambition
planetInSign.Pluto|Aquarius: Transforms society and technology, reshaping community, freedom, and progress
planetInSign.Pluto|Pisces: Transforms the collective psyche, reshaping faith, compassion, and the unconscious

houseAreas.1: self-image and how they meet the world
houseAreas.2: resources, money, and sense of worth
houseAreas.11: friendships, groups, and hopes for the future

aspectNotes.Conjunction: These energies blend and amplify each other.
aspectNotes.Sextile: An easy, supportive link that offers opportunity when used.
aspectNotes.Square: Friction here pushes growth through effort and challenge.
aspectNotes.Trine: A natural, effortless flow of talent between the two.
aspectNotes.Opposition: A push-pull that seeks balance between opposite needs.

elements.Fire: a fiery temperament — driven, enthusiastic, and quick to act
elements.Earth: an earthy temperament — practical, grounded, and reliable
elements.Air: an airy temperament — intellectual, social, and idea-driven
elements.Water: a watery temperament — emotional, intuitive, and empathetic
